changelog:
Initial release of Podcast Monetization Coach—a comprehensive tool for podcasters seeking monetization strategies.

- Guides users through sponsorship strategies (host-read, programmatic, dynamic-insertion), CPM pricing, and media kit creation.
- Offers advice on sponsor outreach, ad-network selection, and effective audience growth tactics.
- Covers premium feed setup (Patreon, Apple, Supercast), affiliate program design, live-event monetization, course/coaching upsells, and branded B2B shows.
- Includes a diagnostic checklist to tailor monetization recommendations to each podcast's current stage and needs.
- Clear triggers for engaging and explicit exclusions for unethical monetization practices.
summary: End-to-end podcast monetization & growth coach. Use when a podcaster asks for sponsorship strategy (host-read, programmatic, dynamic-insertion), CPM pricing,...
